svg.text: Verify improvement and recover on failure
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Security portal, app test and change record
Re-run the relevant assessment or safe check and inspect its timestamp. Assessment results can
lag the local change; verify the actual setting too.
If a change breaks the app, stop rollout and use the recorded recovery plan. Do not return a
known-vulnerable PHP build to service just to restore the login page; the patched-
Record the security and application outcomes separately. A closed alert or a higher score is
not proof that every weakness was fixed.
Check: The weakness has a verified outcome or a controlled failure/recovery record.
